verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio's first-party Phaser Editor has a Scene Editor with drag-and-drop placement, adjustment of animations and physics bodies, an Inspector view for real-time filters, scene reorganisation into layers, and tilemap/atlas editors. The core framework documentation is code-first, however: game objects are added in create() via this.add.sprite, and the editor appears as a separate paid product rather than the primary level-building path. Missing for 10: any evidence of prefabs/reusable components, documentation showing the visual editor as the primary workflow rather than an add-on, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor's depth.
